newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Canada ups ex-Paris cargo rates March 1.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada ups ex-Paris cargo rates March 1.

text.p: Air Canada said it plans to increase its ex-Paris cargo rates to Montreal, Toronto and selected destinations in the U.S. by 30 centimes/kilo, effective March 1.

"The increases work out at around five percent and have been made possible by the steady recovery in the market since October 1996 following a prolonged period of downward pressures on rates," a Paris-based Air Canada cargo official told Reuters.
The official said the strengthening dollar, in relation to European currencies, was also a contributory factor."
Air Canada last increased its ex-Paris cargo rates in March 1996.
The airline operates a daily passenger service between Paris and Montreal and a five times weekly service to Toronto. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax -542
